gloss: to stand at a crossroads; to face a critical decision

definitions.gloss: to stand at a crossroads; to face a critical decision
definitions.explanation: To be at a turning point where an important choice must be made that will significantly affect the future.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}の{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}っている。
examples.english: I'm standing at a crossroads in life.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{今|いま}、{大|おお}きな{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}たされている。
examples.english: The company is now being confronted with a major crossroads.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}するか{今|いま}の{仕事|しごと}を{続|つづ}けるか、{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}った{彼|かれ}は{何日|なんにち}も{悩|なや}み{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: Facing the crossroads of whether to change jobs or stay at his current one, he agonized for days.

notes:
A set expression using {岐路|きろ} (forked road; crossroads) and {立|た}つ (to stand). Almost always used figuratively to describe facing an important life or organizational decision. The passive form {岐路|きろ}に{立|た}たされる (to be placed at a crossroads) emphasizes that external circumstances are forcing the decision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人生|じんせい}の{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}つ: to stand at a crossroads in life
- {重大|じゅうだい}な{岐路|きろ}に{立|た}つ: to face a critical crossroads
- {岐路|きろ}に{立|た}たされる: to be placed at a crossroads (passive)
- {岐路|きろ}に{立|た}った{時|とき}: when facing a crossroads

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転機|てんき}を{迎|むか}える: to reach a turning point — focuses on the moment of change rather than the choice
- {正念場|しょうねんば}: critical moment — emphasizes the pressure of the situation rather than the branching of paths
- {瀬戸際|せとぎわ}: the brink — more urgent, implying a do-or-die situation
